subject.title: [Feature]: Disable image optimization when images are uploaded to Slack

question: Should Slack media delivery honor the existing per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` raw-upload contract, add a separate default-off Slack upload-fidelity setting, or keep the optimizing pipeline as the supported default?
rationale: This affects Slack delivery semantics, config/API surface, and upgrade behavior, so code inspection can prove the gap but cannot choose the public contract safely.

options.title: Honor Existing Per-Call Fidelity Knob
options.body: Wire Slack uploads so `forceDocument`/`asDocument` disables image optimization for explicit file/media sends while leaving current defaults unchanged.

options.title: Add Default-Off Slack Setting
options.body: Add a Slack-owned account/channel setting for raw uploads with docs, tests, and a clear per-call override story.

options.title: Keep Current Optimizing Pipeline
options.body: Document that Slack media uses the shared optimizing loader and close or narrow this request if maintainers do not want a Slack fidelity contract.

recommendation.title: Honor Existing Per-Call Fidelity Knob
recommendation.body: Wire Slack uploads so `forceDocument`/`asDocument` disables image optimization for explicit file/media sends while leaving current defaults unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans shared media loading, Slack delivery, and config compatibility where the strongest current history points.
